common_intent_requirements.text: 一杯冰水的杯外已经有小水珠
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 一杯冰水的杯外已经有小水珠
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Small droplets are already present on the cold exterior at the start, with ice and water softly visible through the intact glass behind them.
a static macro shot frames the outer wall of a glass of ice water

common_intent_requirements.text: 看水珠慢慢变大、聚在一起
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 看水珠慢慢变大、聚在一起
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Existing droplets slowly grow, and neighboring droplets meet and merge into a larger bead with a continuous changing outline.

common_intent_requirements.text: 别让水从杯壁里冒出来
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 别让水从杯壁里冒出来
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Water accumulates on the exterior through condensation from the humid air; the water inside remains behind the unbroken glass wall.

physics_checks.criterion: 外壁液滴变化与冷凝、接触聚并相容，完整杯壁不漏水。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 外壁小水珠缓慢增长，相邻水珠接触后合并，或大珠沿外表面下滑。
fail_examples: 杯内水流穿透完整杯壁
未接触的小水珠隔空瞬移合并
一帧内整面凭空出现巨大水团
not_required: 不要求每颗水珠都变大或合并
不要求十二秒内出现特定水量
不根据水珠外观断言测得露点

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
